scope: Join existing coding harness observations to request/attempt, destination artifact, independent verdict and actual usage. No new workflow runtime.
completion_rules: All scenario/repeat IDs are unique and match the pinned manifest exactly; extra retries are preserved, never substituted for failed runs.
Manifest and expected outcomes are frozen before execution; unknown/missing means not passed.
Native live runs use configured real providers and are distinguished from controlled responses. The live retry needs an observed failed attempt and a real subsequent successful attempt.
Checker reconstructs summary from raw records; reject forged verdict/foreign revision/foreign attempt or missing artifacts.
Zero missing joins only applies to required entities. Not-applicable fields carry explicit reasons, not fabricated IDs.
Unreported cost remains null; all reported attempts including failures and verifier work are attributed without double counting.
A Goal proof and separate human acceptance are recorded after evidence; code/CI alone is not Goal completion.
retry-success must reconstruct the exact nonzero reported_usage_fixture totals in each repetition, including failed attempts and verifier work. Returning null for reported fixture values fails.
Required/applicable entities and phase boundaries are pinned per scenario in the pre-run manifest. Observed rows and the checker cannot waive a required join by declaring not-applicable.
Cost fixture decimals are exact decimal USD strings; they are synthetic observations and not measured real-provider spend.
